rules: Use tinted greys, never pure #000000 or #808080. Tint with blue/navy for this corporate theme.
Hover states must be explicitly set and have a lighter hue of the active state.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with crisp borders.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Dashboards (expose the skeleton). 1px subtle borders (border-border). For overlays (headers/dropdowns), use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 with 1px delicate inner stroke). NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/overlays.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows on cards (shadow-sm). Focus on crisp edges rather than heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Nested radii: child <= parent; concentric. Prefer rounded-md for a sharp corporate look.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: Mode B (High Density Grid). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Fixed left sidebar (240-280px) for desktop navigation. Hamburger menu for mobile only. The sidebar should have a distinct but subtle background separation (e.g. bg-muted/50).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content, forms, and paragraphs. Right-align numbers in tables.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing around containers. Use p-6 or p-8 inside bordered cards.

component_guidelines.data_entry_forms: Single-column flow only. Validate inline (on blur). Keep fields minimal. Show specific, actionable error messages directly under fields. Ensure CTAs are unmissable, full-width or distinctly large.
component_guidelines.data_tables: High density. Include pagination over infinite scroll. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Use specific Empty States (e.g., 'No hay registros' + Actionable CTA).
component_guidelines.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover on actionable cards: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-md).
component_guidelines.buttons: Modern sharp or slightly rounded buttons (rounded-md) with interaction animations. Primary color should be strictly limited to main calls-to-action.

rules: NO transition: all. Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Use text shadow when text overlays images.
accessibility.interactive: Hit areas must be at least 44x44px for mobile targets. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='admin-create-user-btn').

media_and_assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a high-end, clean corporate aesthetic.

login_background.description: Abstract modern glass architecture for a professional corporate login page background.

dashboard_accent.description: Minimalist office desk. Can be used for profile empty states, onboarding headers, or welcome banners.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire UI MUST be written in Spanish (Español) as requested.
App structure: 1. Login Page -> 2. Central Portal/Dashboard (Shows available form apps as cards based on user role) -> 3. Form Apps / Admin Panel.
Roles: Admin, Editor, User. Admin gets a specific view to create users and assign application access.
Forms: Implement typical corporate data-entry forms (e.g., 'Formulario de Ingreso de Clientes', 'Reporte de Incidentes').
Tables: Display submitted forms in a high-density, paginated table view.
Use Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, forms, and dialogs. Write raw Tailwind HTML for layouts.
Use `.js` or `.jsx` extensions for React files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays ONLY, not for data cards.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons instead.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
